mapper.select: INSERT INTO food_history(user_id,food_id,action_type,previous_storage_type,new_storage_type, quantity_text,changes_text,recorded_food_name,operation_id,processed_quantity_amount, quantity_unit,after_quantity_amount,after_snapshot,snapshot_version,after_item_version, after_stock_revision,cooking_id,category_before,category_after,created_at) SELECT i.user_id,i.food_id,'COOK_IN',NULL,i.storage_type,i.quantity_text,#{changes},m.food_name, #{id},i.quantity_amount,i.quantity_unit,i.quantity_amount, to_jsonb(i)||jsonb_build_object('food_name',m.food_name,'category',m.category, 'category_major_code',m.category_major_code,'category_minor_code',m.category_minor_code), 1,i.version_no,i.stock_revision,#{id}, ,clock_timestamp() FROM food_item i JOIN food_master m USING(master_id) WHERE i.user_id=#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND i.food_id=#{foodId} RETURNING history_id
